meta.name: list-adapters
meta.description: Show every capability the engine knows about and which provider backs it (built-in TypeScript, bundled YAML, or user-installed YAML), with availability flags reflecting whether each provider's API key is set. Use when the user says 'list adapters', 'show me which providers are configured', 'which providers are available', 'what capabilities can YALC use right now', or 'show capability coverage'. Read-only — never writes anything.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 列出所有可用适配器及其提供商和配置状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速了解当前引擎支持哪些能力提供商及其密钥配置状态。
copy.tagline_en: List all available adapters with providers and configuration status
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly see which capability providers are available and their API key status.

howto.what: 列出引擎已知的所有能力（capability）及其背后的提供者（provider），标记每个提供者的可用性（环境变量是否已设置）和优先级。只读取信息，不做任何修改。
howto.when: 当用户说出“list adapters”、“show me which providers are configured”等类似关键词时触发。

say.note: 展示所有能力及提供者列表。

say.text: show me which providers are configured
say.note: 显示当前已配置的提供者及可用状态。
列出所有可用的提供者及其能力。

howto.what_en: Displays all known capabilities and their backing providers (built-in, bundled, or user-installed), with availability flags (✓ if env vars set, ✗ if not) and priority ranking. Read-only, never writes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says 'list adapters', 'show me which providers are configured', 'which providers are available', or similar queries about the adapter registry.

say_en.note: Shows full capability and provider inventory.

say_en.text: show me which providers are configured
say_en.note: Displays configured providers and their availability.
Lists all available providers per capability.
